text.p: Diversified conglomerate Shenzhen Zhonghao (Group) Co Ltd recorded net profits of 8.81 million yuan for 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.056 yuan and turnover reached 169.72 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards, or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net losses of 11.51 million yuan under Chinese standards.
The company has proposed no dividend for 1996, but plans a one-for-10 bonus issue based on capital reserves, the exchange said.
Trading in Zhonghao's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
